a: Sikh Roots - Gurbani Kirtan, Katha and more.
d:
San Jose Gurdwara and Bay Area Raag Naad Parivaar planned a special 3-day event “31 Raag Gurmat Sangeet Darbar” between August 31 and September 2, 2018. Renowned international and local Kirtani’s, trained in this rich art form, performed in ALL 31 Gurmat Sangeet Raga’s.
Celebrating the 1st Parkash of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji – the only holy scripture wholly composed in musical ‘Ragas’. The place of honor accorded to ‘Shabad Kirtan’ in the Sikh religion is unparalleled and not found in any other faith or community.
Visit 31RaagNaad.org for more information.
